verdict.rationale: Qdrant is a vector search engine and database, not an agent or AI host that calls tools. Consuming MCP servers as a client is a category error for this product type. The evidence points the opposite way: an official Qdrant MCP server and agent skills let other agents use Qdrant, which is server-side and does not make this client axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
